name: ice devil
lore:
Ice devils, more formally known as gelugons, are formidable denizens of the Nine Hells, embodying the chilling cruelty and calculated strategy that defines the infernal hierarchy. Their imposing forms, often described as towering figures encased in ice and exuding an aura of intense cold, inspire dread in even the most seasoned adventurers. Gelugons are not mere brutes; they are cunning tacticians and merciless leaders, valuing discipline and efficiency above all else. 

Feared for their mastery over ice and cold, gelugons command frozen fortresses and glacial plains within the lower planes. They wield spears of pure ice that can shatter bone and freeze the very soul. Their presence chills the air, and their gaze can freeze the heart of the bravest warrior. Encounters with these devils are often preceded by a sudden drop in temperature and the crunch of ice underfoot, a grim warning of the icy doom that awaits. 

More than just powerful warriors, ice devils are also adept at manipulating others. They carefully orchestrate events to maximize suffering and advance the cause of evil. Their loyalty to the archdevils is unwavering, and they execute their orders with ruthless precision, making them indispensable assets in the eternal war against the forces of good.
